summary: Sporting News previews Tuesday's NHL national games (Red Wings at Rangers and Devils at Avalanche) and offers four SuperDraft player prop picks, with injuries to stars on several teams shaping the picks. The picks are Artemi Panarin and Daniel Sprong to go over on shots, Jesper Bratt under 0.5 assists, and Cale Makar over 2.5 shots. The article also explains SuperDraft's parlay payouts, with a 10x return if all four hit.
one_line: Sporting News gives four SuperDraft NHL prop picks for Tuesday's Red Wings-Rangers and Devils-Avalanche games, led by Panarin and Makar shots overs.
key_facts: Tuesday's NHL national games were Red Wings at Rangers at Madison Square Garden and Devils at Avalanche in Colorado.
Dylan Larkin is a game-time decision for the Red Wings, while Rangers Adam Fox, Filip Chytil and Igor Shesterkin are out injured.
Jack Hughes and Nico Hischier are out until further notice for the Devils.
SuperDraft pays 3X the amount wagered on a two-legged player prop parlay, and 10x if all four props hit (a $20 entry yields $200).
Pick 1: Artemi Panarin OVER 3 shots on goal; he has had at least three SOG in nine of 11 games, going over three in six of them.

Panarin sees 18.8 percent of his shifts start in the offensive zone under new head coach Peter Laviolette, and the Red Wings have allowed the 11th most SOG (371) and the fourth most power play opportunities (46).
Pick 2: Daniel Sprong OVER 2.5 shots on goal; he averages five shot attempts per game through 12 games and has hit the over in five straight, with 18 SOG versus eight combined for his two linemates.
Pick 3: Jesper Bratt UNDER 0.5 assists; he has seven goals and 11 assists in 11 games but has had no assist in each of the last two games since Hughes was injured against the Blues.
With Hischier also out, Michael McLeod centers Bratt and Tyler Toffoli for the Devils.
Pick 4: Cale Makar OVER 2.5 shots on goal; he has gone over in each of the last two games after going under in five of the previous six, and averages 5.9 shot attempts per game.
Makar is Colorado's top defenseman and a key piece of its power play.
SuperDraft promo code "TSN" offers a free $10 deposit.
